content.short: Squid is a cross-chain liquidity and messaging router that enables one-click swaps across multiple blockchains.
content.description:
Squid Router is a premier cross-chain swap and liquidity routing protocol built on the Axelar Network, designed to eliminate the friction of multi-chain asset management. The platform enables users to execute "one-click" swaps between any token on any supported network—such as swapping native ETH on Ethereum for native SOL on Solana—in a single transaction. By utilizing Axelar's General Message Passing (GMP), Squid can execute complex logic across different blockchain architectures while maintaining high throughput and security.

The platform features "Squid Boost," a specialized protocol that completes cross-chain transactions in as little as 2 to 60 seconds, significantly faster than traditional bridges. Operating across over 40 blockchain networks, Squid acts as a vital infrastructure layer for the decentralized web, providing the liquidity needed for developers to build seamless multi-chain applications. Through its commitment to interoperability and user-centric design, Squid Router is building the essential framework for a more unified and accessible global digital economy.
